steps: A lathed part is subjected to roughing milling on a vertical milling machine for 54 minutes using a carbide end mill at a milling speed of 850 rpm and a depth of cut of 2.5 mm, resulting in a milled part that is transferred to a conveyor belt.

The laser cutter performs laser cutting on sheet metal for 61 minutes, using a laser power of 3000 W, a cutting speed of 2.1 m/min, and nitrogen as the gas assist, resulting in cut sheet metal that is then transferred to a conveyor belt.

On a Horizontal Lathe, a metal bar is turned into a lathed part for 35 minutes using a tungsten carbide insert tool at a rotation speed of 650 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, after which the finished part is transferred to a mobile robot.

A planed part is loaded from a mobile robot onto a grinding machine where it undergoes surface grinding for 5 minutes using an aluminum oxide grinding wheel rotating at 1500 m/min with a feed rate of 0.05 mm/pass, resulting in a ground part that is then transferred to a conveyor belt.

Using a broaching machine, an internal broaching operation is performed on a lathed part loaded from a conveyor belt, utilizing a pull-type broach with a precision level of ±0.02 mm, taking 48 minutes to complete, resulting in a broached component that is transferred to a mobile robot.

The precision drilling operation is performed on a Drill Press, where the Broached component is machined to create holes with a diameter of 8 mm and a tolerance of ±0.05 mm, taking 33 minutes to complete, after which the resulting Finished part with holes is transferred to a ConveyorBelt.

Using a punch press, a sheet metal component is punched with a 12 mm circular punch at a stroke speed of 80 strokes per minute and automatic die alignment for 21 minutes, transforming it into a finished sheet metal product that is then transferred to a mobile robot.

On a CNC Turning Center, a finish turning operation is performed on a lathed part loaded from a MobileRobot, using CNC program Program_087 with verified and calibrated tool offsets and a spindle speed of 950 rpm, taking 65 minutes to produce a finished machined component that is then transferred to a ConveyorBelt.

On the Honing Machine, a cylinder honing operation is performed on a honed cylinder to achieve precision finishing, using a 220 grit honing stone to reach a bore size of 50.0 mm ± 0.005 mm, lasting for 83 minutes, after which the precision finished part is transferred to a MobileRobot.

The Milled part is subjected to surface planing on a Planer for 78 minutes, achieving a planing depth of 1.8 mm and a feed rate of 0.3 mm/stroke to produce a Planed part with a surface finish of 3.2 μm Ra, which is then placed on a ConveyorBelt.

The Shear (Sheet Metal) machine performs a shearing operation on sheet metal, cutting it to size using a hardened steel straight-edge blade with a 2-degree shear angle and a cutting speed of 1 cut per 14 seconds, taking 14 minutes to complete, after which the resulting sheared sheet metal is transferred to a mobile robot.

On a Screw Machines, the Screw Threading operation is performed on a Lathed part loaded from a MobileRobot, creating metric coarse threads of size M10 at a production rate of 120 parts per hour, and the resulting Screwed component is placed on a ConveyorBelt, all taking 70 minutes.

Perform finish milling on a milled part using a horizontal milling machine for 25 minutes at a milling speed of 1200 rpm with a climb milling tool path to achieve a surface finish of 1.6 μm Ra, loading the part from a conveyor belt and transferring the finished machined component to a mobile robot upon completion.

On a Hobbing Machine, a gear hobbing operation is performed on a broached component to produce a hobbied gear with a spur gear profile and 20° pressure angle, running at a hobbing speed of 450 rpm and a feed rate of 0.5 mm/rev, lasting for 36 minutes, after which the hobbied gear is transferred to a conveyor belt.

The Stewart Platform Mills performs precision 5-axis milling on a milled part taken from the ConveyorBelt, using a 30-degree ball end mill with active damping system engaged and a milling precision of ±0.01 mm, transforming it into a ground part that is then placed on the MobileRobot, and the operation takes 56 minutes.
